official_definition: Great Assault: X - (When Attacks) This spirit can, X per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses. When this Spirit is refreshed by this effect, discard 5 cards from the top of opponent's deck.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Great Assault] or [Great Assault: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Great Assault]", "give [Great Assault]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
